primary.$description: The app's interactive accent. Indigo-600 here because primary is mostly an ink on paper: 5.71:1 on the scaffold.

on-primary.$description: Label on a primary fill: 6.29:1 on indigo-600.

primary-container.$description: Contained companion of the brand: the nav indicator, the fill a label sits on when raw indigo would miss AA.

secondary.$description: Secondary indigo; the same step as primary on paper.

secondary-container.$description: Fill behind a selected segment, deliberately further from paper than the containers so the selected state reads at a glance.

on-secondary-container.$description: Label on a selected segment, at full strength.

tertiary.$description: The success tone as a scheme role.

error.$description: The unreachable tone as a scheme role.

on-error.$description: Label on an error fill: white measures 3.76:1 there, this ink 4.71:1.

surface.$description: Paper: the scaffold behind every screen.

on-surface.$description: Ink (gray-900): primary text and icons on every surface and container.

surface-container-lowest.$description: Sub-floor: recessed wells such as log panels and code blocks.

surface-container-low.$description: Riser: grouped-list backgrounds. The same byte as surface.

surface-container.$description: Card White: cards and KPI tiles. Sheets, dialogs and the navigation bar sit on surface in this theme.

surface-container-high.$description: Cool Paper: secondary panels and the ground accent chips most often sit on.

surface-container-highest.$description: Warm Grey: input and chip fill, carrying on-surface-variant labels.

on-surface-variant.$description: Secondary Ink: metadata, chip labels, input hints, unselected nav. Clears AA on all four paper grounds (worst 5.94:1).

dim-text.$description: Dim Ink: editorial captions and tertiary metadata. Clears AA on all four paper grounds (worst 4.75:1).

outline.$description: Hairline: dividers, outlined buttons and cards, the rare boundary a tint cannot draw.

outline-variant.$description: Grouped surfaces, genre chips, KPI tile border. The same byte as outline.

shadow.$description: The ink every elevation level paints its shadow in: ink, not black, so a shadow reads as depth rather than grime on paper.

on-inverse-surface.$description: Snackbar text on the inverse surface.

inverse-primary.$description: The brand on an inverse surface.

glass-surface.$description: Opacity of surface-container in the floating nav bar's glass fill. A tint, not a backdrop blur.

ambient-glow.$description: Centre of the ambient accent wash behind headers and the onboarding canvas.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-1 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-1 ambient shadow.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-2 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-2 ambient shadow.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-3 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-3 ambient shadow.
Opacity of the glass bar's ambient shadow.

highlight.$description: Opacity of the glass bar's 1px top highlight.
